name: ribosomal protein S15
pathways: positive regulation of signal transduction by p53 class mediator

function.text: RPS15 encodes small ribosomal subunit protein uS19. Annotated molecular activities include ubiquitin ligase inhibitor activity and structural constituent of ribosome. It participates in positive regulation of signal transduction by p53 class mediator and translation.
